title: Elo Tournament
description: IDEATE-stage artifact (absorption wave 1; Google co-scientist Elo debate + Stanford AI-Researcher Swiss pattern). Output of tools/elo_tournament.py: deterministic Elo ratings computed over LLM pairwise simulated-debate judgments (the idea-tournament-ranker judges each matchup and records a rationale ref; the TOOL does the bookkeeping — ratings math is never an LLM call). Ratings are EVIDENCE for the /idea-bet menu. No selected/chosen/picked field: the director picks via the /idea-bet gate. winner MUST equal pair_a or pair_b (enforced by elo_tournament.py and tests).

winner.description: idea_id of the judged winner — MUST equal pair_a or pair_b.

rationale_ref.description: Reference to the per-matchup debate rationale (bundle path / artifact ref) — every judgment is auditable.

rank.description: 1 = highest Elo; contiguous 1..N; stable tiebreak by idea_id.
